label: Chip antenna (antenna-chip4)
description:
Chip antenna

Single endded antenna. Common with smaller chip antennas. CHIP4 package is the GPS Chip Antenna SKU: GPS-08418. CHIP5 package is 2.4GHz chip antenna SKU: WRL-00144.
